rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

companies.name: コカ・コーラ・コンソリデーテッド

relations.text: ウォルマートとクローガーが最大の顧客(小売向け販売数量の約36%)
relations.text_en: Walmart and Kroger are its largest customers, about 36% of retail bottle/can volume

source.label: Coca-Cola Consolidated 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: The Company's largest customers, Walmart Inc. and The Kroger Co., accounted for approximately 36% of the Company's 2024 total bottle/can sales volume to retail customers

companies.name: バイタル・ファームズ

relations.text: 主要な小売顧客の一社にクローガー
relations.text_en: Names Kroger among key retail customers

source.label: Vital Farms 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: We have reached a broad set of consumers through a variety of retail partners, including Albertsons, Kroger, Publix, Whole Foods, Sprouts Farmers Market

relations.text: クローガーとの協業を取引先との関係の代表例に挙げる
relations.text_en: Cites its partnership with Kroger as a model customer relationship

source.label: Suja Life S-1(2026年4月)
source.quote: Our partnership with Kroger is one of many examples that showcases our ability to evolve well beyond a traditional supplier dynamic into a deep-rooted, collaborative partnership

companies.name: ローカル・バウンティ

relations.text: 主要な小売顧客の一社にクローガー
relations.text_en: Names Kroger among its blue-chip retail customers

source.label: Local Bounti 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: primarily through direct relationships with blue-chip retail customers, including Albertsons, Sam's Club, Kroger, Target, Walmart

companies.name: エディブル・ガーデン

relations.text: 販売先のスーパーにクローガー
relations.text_en: Sells its herbs through Kroger among other supermarkets

source.label: Edible Garden 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our herb product portfolio is sold through our supermarket partners including Walmart, Target, Meijer, Hannaford, Ahold/Delhaize, Kroger

relations.text: 合併契約は解消され、違約金6億ドルをめぐりクローガーを提訴
relations.text_en: Merger agreement terminated; Albertsons is suing Kroger over the $600 million termination fee

source.label: Albertsons 10-K(2025年2月期)
source.quote: resulting in ongoing costs that we may be required to pay in connection with the lawsuit against Kroger, or our inability to collect the $600 million termination fee from Kroger

relations.text: クローガーの薬局向け会員割引プログラムで提携していた
relations.text_en: Previously partnered with Kroger on a paid savings program

source.label: GoodRx 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: For example, we previously partnered with Kroger, one of the largest retail pharmacies in the United States, to offer Kroger Savings to their consumers for an annual fee

relations.text: 米国の主な総合小売の競合にクローガーを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Kroger among significant U.S. general merchandise competitors

source.label: Costco 10-K(2025年8月期)
source.quote: Walmart, Target, Kroger, and Amazon are among our significant general merchandise retail competitors in the U.S.

companies.name: イングルズ・マーケッツ

relations.text: 主な競合にクローガーと傘下ハリス・ティーターを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Kroger and its Harris Teeter among principal competitors

source.label: Ingles Markets 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: Harris Teeter (owned by The Kroger Co.), The Kroger Co.

companies.name: アムコン・ディストリビューティング

relations.text: 自然食品で競合する大手スーパーにクローガーを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Kroger among supermarkets competing in natural and organic products

source.label: AMCON Distributing 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: Conventional supermarkets and mass market outlets such as Kroger, Albertsons, Walmart, Trader Joe's and Costco have also significantly increased their offerings of organic and natural products

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
